facts.fact: The national statistics strategy lists law no. 2005-017 of 27 January 2005 on public statistics, the 'statistics law', as the main text governing public statistical activity, and says the law had not been revised.
facts.system: Loi n° 2005-017 relative à la statistique publique (2005)

facts.fact: Decree no. 2006-024 of 17 April 2006 sets the organisation and operating rules of the National Statistical Council, created in application of the statistics law.
facts.system: Loi n° 2005-017 relative à la statistique publique (2005)

facts.fact: Order no. 1012/MEF/08 of 30 March 2008 appointed the members of the National Statistical Council, the body created under the statistics law.
facts.system: Loi n° 2005-017 relative à la statistique publique (2005)
